name: PM-KISAN
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three instalments for qualifying landholding farmer families, subject to exclusions.
documents: Identity proof requested by the official portal
Bank account details (only on official application portal)
steps: Follow official registration or CSC guidance

name: Kisan Credit Card
benefit: Credit support for eligible farming and allied activities, subject to bank assessment.
documents: Landholding or cultivation evidence where applicable
steps: Submit an application through the selected bank

name: PM Awas Yojana — Urban
benefit: Housing assistance under applicable PMAY-U components. Benefit and qualifying criteria differ by component.
steps: Check the current PMAY-U phase and component
Confirm detailed component eligibility on the official portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
benefit: Foodgrain support for eligible NFSA beneficiary households.
documents: NFSA ration card or other accepted beneficiary proof
steps: Check NFSA status with the state food department

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
benefit: Up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for covered hospitalisation under the applicable beneficiary rules.
documents: Identity proof requested by authorized enrolment channels
steps: Verify beneficiary status through official PM-JAY channels
